items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: And I borrowed whatever I could from Ellis, you know...

ctx.x: No. See, when I came up, there was him and Don Abney -- he's another one... That's another school of piano playing that I was exposed to. And I borrowed whatever I could from Ellis, you know... In that way I became a little popular with some singers.
I see. Actually, we've taken you roughly to about 1933 or so, isn't it.
